meta.title: Warlock data sheet for WoW Forever (level 60 vs a level 63 training dummy): Affliction, Demonology, Destruction, DS/Ruin and the demons
meta.scope: Spell table and caster rules, every ability a level-60 warlock uses against a raid boss, Curses vs Banes, Life Tap and health, procs and debuffs, the demons and a practice-yard pet model, the three talent trees in gunba's order with per-rank values, every warlock build in gs and fs (plus MythicSim's secondary ranking), priority lists, default stats, worked examples, a Life Tap/health design note and the engine gaps.
meta.howToRead: Every number is an object {value, unit, source, confidence, note}. 'source' is a GitHub permalink (repo@commit/path#Lline), a URL, or a list of them. 'confidence' is one of the three values in confidenceLegend. Spell rows cited as fs sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go are the beta client rows (build 1.60.1.70124) stored in foreversim. Damage values are the level-60 client values; Wowhead tooltips print each rank at its maximum scaling level (e.g. Shadow Bolt 263-292 at level 65).

confidenceLegend.confirmed-forever: Stated by Forever client data (spell rows, talent curves), a Wowhead Forever tooltip, Blizzard (development notes, class deep dive), or measured on the beta (mostly levels 10-30).
confidenceLegend.sim-provisional: A modelling choice of one or both sims with no Forever source yet, or where sources disagree (including developer-style bug-tracker replies not flagged as Blizzard). Use it, but expect it to change.
confidenceLegend.classic-fallback: Forever data is silent, so the sims keep the Classic 1.12 / Classic Era value.

simsCompared.gs: gunba/wow-forever-sim (branch 'forever'), commit 9c05fc890b (2026-10-09). Engine: wowsims/classic with Forever rules. Warlock tree 17/19/16 (TalentTreeSizes). Four presets (Demonic Pact, Affliction, DS/Ruin, Destruction/Shadow and Flame) with APLs, modeled ilvl-65 ranked results, client-checked spell tables (docs/beta-pass/warlock.md). Life Tap's health is not charged to a non-tanking warlock (external-healing abstraction). Pets inherit owner stats. No Hellfire.
simsCompared.fs: laurencestokes/foreversim (branch 'master'), commit 255df1627f (2026-10-01). Engine: wowsims/forever reading the beta client rows (1.60.1.70124). Same tree order as gs. Life Tap removes health. Demons inherit nothing. Its APLs never cast Bane of Doom, and its 'Shadow and Flame' APL casts no Incinerate or Conflagrate. Test results use naked gear; race-breakdown docs give pre-BiS 180 s DPS.

practiceYardSummary: Spell table vs +3: 17% miss, 1% floor (hit cap +16%); gear hit counts for spells; average 6% level-based partial resist on non-binary damage; spell crit 1.5x, 2.0x with Ruin 5/5 (Destruction spells) or Pandemic 3/3 (Corruption, Banes, drains, Siphon Life, Wrack). DoT ticks crit and are dynamic.

Curses and Banes are separate per-warlock slots. Banes: Agony (552 over 24 s, ramping), Doom (1742 + 4.0 SP after 60 s, 60 s CD), Havoc. Curses: Elements (all magic +10%, -75 res), Recklessness (-505 armor), Weakness, Tongues, Exhaustion. Curse of Shadow is gone.

Life Tap: (424 + Spirit) x (1 + 0.1 x Improved Life Tap) health -> the same mana, instant, 1.5 s GCD, no threat. Warlocks spend ~9,000 mana/min; the yard needs a health bar plus a 'raid healing' setting.

Shadow Bolt r10 3 s (2.5 with Bane) 380 mana 253-283 +0.857; Immolate 2 s 158 +0.2 then 5 x 55 +0.13; Corruption 2 s (-0.4 s per Improved Corruption point) 6 x 73 +0.2; Incinerate (talent) 2.5 s 201-233 +0.714 +25% on Immolate; Conflagrate 10 s 251-313 +0.429; Shadowburn 15 s 258-288 +0.429.

Demonic Sacrifice: Imp +15% Shadow, Succubus +15% Fire, Voidwalker 2% mana/4 s, Felhunter 3% health/4 s, 2 h; Demonic Pact keeps it while another demon is out. Succubus melee 95-131 @ 2.0 + Lash of Pain 50 +0.429 every 12 s; Imp Firebolt 2 s cast ~44 +0.571.
gs ranks Demonic Pact ~916-930, Affliction ~826-835, Shadow and Flame ~813-820, DS/Ruin ~791-805 DPS (modeled ilvl 65, 300 s). No tank warlock exists in Forever.

missVsPlus3.unit: % with 0 hit; 1% floor, so +16% hit caps
missVsPlus3.note: Classic value kept (UnitLevelFloat64 4/5/6/17). DoTs, curses and banes roll hit once on application; ticks never miss. Paladin and hunter sheets use the same 17%.

hitSources.value: Gear hit (counts for spells), Suppression +1%/point (also melee hit, which the demon inherits)

critSuppression.note: gs has a TODO and applies none to spells.

partialResists.note: Level-based: 2% per level of average mitigation on non-binary spells and DoT ticks; resist coefficient 0.08 -> thresholds 0.1824 / 0.0504 / 0.0072. Binary spells miss or land in full. Curse of the Elements' -75 resistance has no effect against 0 resistance.

critMultiplier.note: Magic crit = 1 + 0.5 x CritDamageBonus; Ruin and Pandemic each add +1.0 bonus at max.

periodicCrit.note: DoT ticks roll crit (Pandemic implies it). Beta bug #303: Siphon Life ticks never crit (219 ticks, 0 crits).

dynamicDots.note: Ticks use the caster's current spell power and multipliers (no snapshot). Community testers on #35 describe Forever DoTs as dynamic.

value.hastedBy: casting speed for magic schools (all warlock spells)

globalCooldown.note: 1.5 s and the off-GCD list are client data; the haste rule and 1.0 s floor follow the WoWSims-style school rule (CORE-004).

value.channels: casting-speed effects do not shorten channels in gs; only the spell haste stat does (none on current gear)

movement.value: No cast or channel while moving (moving cancels it). Castable on the move: Banes, Curses, Corruption at 5/5 Improved Corruption, Siphon Life, Shadowburn, Conflagrate, Death Coil, Life Tap, a Shadow Trance Shadow Bolt.

foreverVsClassic: Curse of Agony and Curse of Doom are Banes (one Bane and one Curse per warlock per target); Curse of Shadow removed; Curse of the Elements covers all magic schools (-75 resistance, +10%); Curse of Recklessness gives no attack power.

Damage ranks roughly halved, coefficients raised: Shadow Bolt r10 253-283 (+0.857), Corruption 438 (0.2/tick), Agony 552 (0.133/tick), Immolate 158 + 275 (0.2/0.13), drains 0.1/tick, Soul Fire 390-487, Searing Pain 107-126, Conflagrate 251-313 (6 ranks), Shadowburn 258-288, Death Coil 460; Bane of Doom 1742 + 4.0 SP.
Life Tap scales with Spirit, not spell power; Dark Pact removed.
DoT ticks can crit and are dynamic; Pandemic and Ruin double crit damage; Hellfire can crit.
Drain Soul gives Soul Shards per tick (progressive chance); stones are weapon imbues that stack with oils; Fel Domination 5 min.

New: Incinerate, Wrack, Bane of Havoc, Demonic Pact, Demonic Brand, Decimation, Demonic Knowledge, Pandemic, Malevolence, Malediction, Soul Siphon, Improved Drains, Fel Vitality, Demonic Energies, Demonic Aegis, Molten Skin, Agonizing Flames, Fire and Brimstone, Shadow and Flame, Improved Felhunter; the Incubus.

Demonic Sacrifice pairings reversed (Imp Shadow, Succubus Fire, Voidwalker mana, Felhunter health), 2 h; Improved Shadow Bolt personal with no charges; Shadow Mastery halved; Unholy Power reduced; Master Demonologist redesigned.
Pets inherit owner stats, cannot be buffed, and the old pet is stunned while you summon; wands no longer gain spell damage.
